scope: Implement the measured PAR-92 / 7BA POLYLINE commit-preparation ordering optimization while preserving declared child order and bounding preparation scratch.

behavior: Replace one find_if over all staged vertices for every declared child, plus repeated ordered-pointer duplicate scans, with a sorted handle/index scratch vector followed by binary lookup in declared source order.

Reject null, missing, duplicate declared, and duplicate staged handles; the caller then performs the same parent-handle and staged-frame validation before retaining pointers into the stable staged vector.

Cap preparation scratch at 64 MiB, including measured actual capacities of the sorted handle/index vector, selected-byte vector, ordered-index vector, prepared ordered pointers, prepared child handles, and any prior ordered-index output capacity.
Keep the original declared handle list authoritative; callback order, geometry, byte layout, public API and reader ownership policy are unchanged.
testCoverage: Generated 512-child scrambled handles must map exactly back to source declaration order.
A counting comparator verifies the sort-and-binary-search path stays below 16,384 handle comparisons for the 512-child control.
Duplicate declared handles, a missing child handle, and a one-byte scratch budget are refused without replacing the caller's prior output vector.
